metadata.label: spam_pgon
metadata.name: Spam pgon
metadata.description: Mass dust-transfer ad spam promoting the @pgon Telegram crypto-fiat wallet (comment with promo code). Operator funds disposable wallet_v5r1 batch wallets that each send 10 x 0.00001 TON with the ad comment, then return the remainder with comment "tonsender batch N" and self-destruct.

addresses.source: https://tonviewer.com/EQDpxZ3Vz6djoJ4JqccosfG7r8WevO9uEwa7eEBtJDt7nrU0 Operator wallet_v5r1: deploys/funds batch wallets with 0.0501 TON every ~6s (seqno >206k), e.g. tx 366373dedbda2e70b4e65fd39d7680882d08a3b8d3cd2b154b2c781b48818a94; receives "tonsender batch N" refunds. ~96k recipients on 2026-10-10.

https://tonviewer.com/EQBR9AGbUDaoL26jm5MJPD79Ro3zoojqROE9-_UlYCu4SjHk Reusable self-destructing batch wallet funded by the operator (e.g. tx ff55a8f86afc902534ff289b784b30a2d059636ab114472890f4ded93605c25e): 10 x 0.00001 TON with comment "@pgon - крипто-фиатный кошелек в ТГ... Промокод - 3ABSA1BERAA8".
